alt: Sabi as one yellow palace-plane in a charcoal void — a single horizontal slab, one tiny silky court speck
prompt: Minimal iconic 16:9 poster. Sabi palace, Baekje capital. ONE geometric device: a single hard HORIZONTAL COLOR PLANE — the palace is one long flat #FFCB51 yellow slab spanning the lower third, not a building, not a dawn cityscape, not a river. Tiny isolated silky Baekje court-hanbok silhouette, one speck on the yellow plane. Flat charcoal void above and below the slab. No boats. No crowd. No clouds. No palace clutter. No text. No watermark. Graphic color-blocking, anime-painterly, monumental.
